in_sanskrit.name: Mukeem
in_sanskrit.meaning: हिन्दू नाम जिसका अर्थ है Strong, Powerful
in_sanskrit.long_meaning: Mukeem एक संस्कृत नाम है जो हिंदू संस्कृति में गहरा आध्यात्मिक महत्व रखता है। The name Mukeem is derived from the Arabic language and means 'strong' or 'powerful'. In Hindu mythology, this name is associated with the god Murugan, who is known for his strength and courage.
